newsitem.title: Australia: Australian debt await RBA decision, GDP data.
newsitem.headline: Australian debt await RBA decision, GDP data.

text.p: *Australian debt futures were firm, albeit below the heady levels seen in after hours trading, as the market pondered the outside chance of a further easing by the RBA.

Australian debt futures were firm, albeit below the heady levels seen in after hours trading, as the market pondered the outside chance of a further easing by the Reserve Bank following Tuesday's board meeting.
A further rate cut was generally seen unlikely at this stage, although the market is not taking any chances given the surprise 50 basis point move to 5.5 percent on May 23.
(But) "if they (the RBA) wanted lower cash rates, why didn't they go 75 basis points or a full point last time round," said one short end trader.
